title: Random forest predicts 2-year progression risk in IgA nephropathy
summary: A random forest model derived in a retrospective cohort of 1,301 biopsy-proven IgA nephropathy patients from two hospitals and externally validated predicted 2-year kidney outcomes. For the primary outcome (30% eGFR decline or end-stage kidney disease) AUC was 0.771 with precision 0.259 and recall 0.875; for proteinuria improvement AUC was 0.694. High-risk versus low-risk groups differed in 10-year kidney outcome (HR 13.00, 9.52-17.77). Precision is low and discrimination modest.
ai_technology: Random forest 2-year risk model for IgA nephropathy with SHAP explanations

evidence.tested: Derivation at one hospital and external validation at a second hospital in 1,301 biopsy-proven patients.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and clinical benefit; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A random forest model predicted rapid progression and proteinuria improvement from biopsy-time data.
